openedFiles.$description: Opened files in the Files panel (owner, 23 November; D-410): a header with its ⋯ menu, then one bordered tab button per open note above Pinned. Borders are the owner's explicit choice.

headerSize.$description: The header reads as a section label, the same size as Pinned and Recent.

strongWeight.$description: The header, and the active tab's name, as the tree marks the open note.

stack.$description: Between the header and the first tab: the header labels the tabs, so it sits closest to them.

tabGap.$description: Between tabs: enough for two borders to read as two boxes.

headerInlineStart.$description: The header's start inset, the same as the tree's rows, so its words line up with Pinned and Recent once the chevron's width is added.

chevronSpace.$description: The width the tree's section chevron takes, kept empty before the header's words so they line up with Pinned and Recent.

inlineGap.$description: Between the file icon, the name and the close button inside a tab.

border.$description: The same outline as a secondary button: the owner asked for tab buttons with borders.

current.$description: The active tab outside a project (standalone files): the quiet fill the tree gives the open note (D-111).

currentProject.$description: The active tab inside a project: the project accent's tint (owner, 24 November 12:42; D-410). The accent scope (D-313) rebinds it to the preset's strong tint in light and soft tint in dark.

borderCurrentProject.$description: The active tab's full outline inside a project, in the project accent; only its colour changes, never its width (D-354). Never a one-sided stripe.

forcedCurrent.$description: The active tab in forced colours (Highlight), fill and outline; it's only used there.

forcedCurrentText.$description: The active tab's name, icon and × in forced colours (HighlightText).

closeSize.$description: The close button's box inside the tab, the same as the tree's row ⋯.
